spans.s:
अरोक अ-रोक, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रुच्), darkened,
obscured, dimmed.
—अरोक-दत्, अत्, अती, अत्, or
अरोक-दन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having black or dis-
coloured teeth, having bad teeth.

आ-रोक, अस्, m. shining through; small points of
light between the threads of a web.

अरोग अ-रोग, अस्, आ, अम्, free from disease,
healthy, well; (अस्), m. health.
आ-रोग, अस्, m., N. of a sun [cf. आ-राग].

अ-रोगण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not rendering sick,
freeing from disease.

अ-रोगिन्, ई, इणि, इ, or अ-रोग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, healthy.
—अरोगि-ता or अरोग्य-ता, f. healthiness, health.

अरोचक अ-रोचक, अस्, इका, अम् (rt. रुच्), not
shining; causing want of appetite or disgust; (अस्), m.
want or loss of appetite, disgust, indigestion.

अ-रोचकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from want of appe-
tite or indigestion.
अ-रोचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, not shining.
अ-रोचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, dark, disagreeable, ugly.

अरोदन अ-रोदन, अम्, n. (rt. रुद्), not
weeping.

अरोध्य अ-रोध्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रुध्), not
to be hindered or obstructed, unobstructed.

अरोपण अ-रोपण, अम्, n. (rt. रुह्), not
planting or fixing.
अरोष अ-रोष, अस्, m. calmness, gentleness.
आ-रोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, shining.
आ-रोधन, अम्, n., Ved. secret place, innermost part.
आ-रोढव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ascended or mounted.

आ-रोढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ, who or what mounts
or rides, &c.

आ-रोप, अस्, m. imposing (as a burden), burdening
with, charging with; placing in or on; assigning or
attributing to; relating to; superior position.

आ-रोपक, अस्, आ, अम्, planting, fixing, causing to
ascend.

आ-रोपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to ascend; to
be raised, placed, &c.

आ-रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, elevated; fixed, placed,
made; strung (as a bow); deposited, intrusted; conse-
crated; accidental, adventitious.
1. आ-रोप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or fixed on or in.

2. आ-रोप्य, ind. having made to ascend, having
caused to mount, having placed upon.

आ-रोप्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being strung, being tried
to be strung.

आ-रोहक, अस्, आ, अम्, ascending; rising; raising
up; (अस्), m. a rider; a tree.

आ-रोहण, अम्, n. the act of rising, ascending; the
rising or growing of new shoots, growing (of plants);
Ved. a carriage; an elevated stage for dancing; a
ladder, a staircase; riding on (a horse &c.).

आरोहणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to ascent or
mounting.

आ-रोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ascending, mounting; one who
mounts or rides.

आरोग्य आरोग्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-रोग), free-
dom from disease, health.
आ-रोध, अस्, m. a siege, blockade.
